sources.entry: Nimbus - Native SoundCloud client with gapless playback, a drag-and-drop queue, Chromecast and a full-screen vinyl player. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Dearonski/Nimbus) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Nimbus is an unofficial, native macOS SoundCloud client built in SwiftUI and AppKit, with gapless playback, a queue, variable-speed "Vinyl" playback, and Chromecast/AirPlay support.
summary.what_it_does: Nimbus plays SoundCloud tracks in a macOS app rather than a browser window. It has a two-deck player that preloads the next track for near-instant track changes, and a playback speed control from 0.5x to 2x with an optional mode where pitch changes with tempo. A full-screen vinyl view shows a spinning record with the track's comments appearing over the title at their timestamps. The app also supports a rearrangeable queue, playlists, comments, likes, reposts, follows, and an activity feed. Casting is available via Chromecast and AirPlay, and it reads search and browsing across what you have already loaded. Sign-in happens in a web view using your own session, and the README describes it as talking to SoundCloud's internal API.
use_cases: listen to SoundCloud on a Mac
play SoundCloud tracks through Chromecast or AirPlay
slow down or speed up tracks
manage a SoundCloud queue and playlists
comment on and like tracks from the desktop
how_to_run: Or download Nimbus-.dmg from Releases and drag Nimbus into Applications
git clone (repository URL not given in README)
Run the Nimbus scheme with your own Apple developer account selected; tools/release.sh builds the DMG
notable: Full-screen vinyl player with a spinning record, cover-colour background, and timed comment display
Two-deck playback that preloads the next track for near-instant track changes
Playback speed from 0.5x to 2x, with pitch kept or following tempo
Comments, likes, reposts and follows are read and write, not view-only
Built as a Mac app with Now Playing, media keys, and Music-style menus and shortcuts
caveats: Requires macOS 26.0 or later on Apple Silicon; no Intel build and no fallback for earlier macOS versions
Build is signed but not notarised, so first launch needs a manual 'Open Anyway' step in System Settings
Unofficial client using SoundCloud's internal API; meant for personal use and subject to SoundCloud's Terms of Service
Go+ and region-locked tracks are skipped
